notes.title: LSP Selection for the 2024 Summer Next Festival
notes.content:
We are bringing you the "2024 LSP Summer Next Festival" from June 11th to 17th! During the event, new plans will be revealed daily, and there will be updates to the free game inventory. Several upcoming titles will also release demos and developer live streams. Check out the Chinese romance games worth your attention—

[h3]■ 2024 Summer New Plans Unveiled[/h3]


During the event, our official Weibo and the LSP New Product page will daily announce new plans joining the LSP lineup. On June 17th, we will also conduct a self-selection activation code lottery for the aforementioned titles through LSP Lotto. Can anyone guess what games they might be?

The official Weibo activity post is currently hosting a 888 RMB lucky draw red envelope forwarding event. Feel free to participate!

[b]>>[url=https://weibo.com/5877446372/]Go to WEIBO to participate[/url][/b]


[h3]■ Upcoming New Game Demos and Developer Livestreams[/h3]

Surprise! The creators of these games are all ladies!

Our titles "Shadow Album" and "Find the Demon" have conducted developer playthroughs (face reveal?). The livestream replays and game trial versions are already available on their store pages. On June 14th, "Dreamless Girl" will release a brand new fully remade demo. Feel free to watch and download for an experience.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2717570/Find_the_Demon/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2696120/Photo_Idol_Shadow_Album/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2242840/Dreamless_Girl/


[h3]■ Continuous Free Game Giveaways[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751563/2cc42e7b3266f98b9210d841ccbd0b1e60485a0c.png[/img]

Game activation code giveaways! Register on the website to participate and easily qualify for the giveaways. During the event, LSP+1 will update the inventory every weekday, giving out a total of 1000 activation codes!

In addition to old titles, newly released games such as "PureLove Monologue", "Mirror Sugar Acacia", "The Street of Adrift", and "Succuboss" will also be added to the inventory. Check back every day after work or school!

[b]>>[url=https://www.lspsp.me/]Go to the LSP official website[/url][/b]
